snippet.title: Monopoly: Star Wars Heroes vs. Villains | World Premiere Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the World Premiere trailer of Monopoly: Star Wars™ Heroes vs. Villains.

Step into the Star Wars galaxy with a bold new twist on MONOPOLY, launching June 11.

Pre‑order now and unlock two unique in‑game dice skins at launch.

#MonopolyStarWars
